observations: Single rear/three-quarter view of a motorcycle parked on a dirt path beside grass.
Blue fuel tank with red/white stripe, black single seat, rear luggage rack visible.
Exhaust pipe, rear shock, and rear wheel visible; front wheel and engine area not clearly shown.
No brand badge, model name, or VIN plate is legible anywhere in the image.
Watermark text 'POSTED ON... OLAMILEKAN USMAN' overlays the photo, not part of the bike.
Tires appear worn/dirty; no close-up of tread or sidewall markings.
No odometer, speedometer close-up, engine number, or registration papers shown.

claims.evidence: No engine start, ride, or close mechanical shot provided; condition cannot be judged from a static rear photo.
No Suzuki logo, tank badge, or engine casing marking is visible or legible in photo 0.
No video, sound clip, or multi-angle photos to assess mechanical or electrical faults.

risks.proof: Video of engine starting and idling, plus photo of engine block close-up.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing mechanical inspection

risks.risk: Brand/model unconfirmed, affects parts availability and resale value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of tank badge, frame plate, or engine casing showing 'Suzuki' and model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded motorcycle, not as Suzuki-specific model

risks.risk: Tire condition and front wheel/brake condition not visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front wheel, brakes, and both tire treads.

risks.risk: No proof of ownership, registration, or vehicle papers (common resale risk in Nigeria).
risks.proof: Photo of registration/particulars document or plate number matching seller's name.
risks.if_unproven: priced with added risk discount for unverifiable title

risks.risk: Possible accident or frame damage hidden by angle/grass.
risks.proof: Full side-view photo and front-on photo in clear daylight.

proof_requests: Clear photo of tank/engine badge showing Suzuki brand and model name
Video of engine starting and running
Full side view and front view photos in good light
Photo of registration papers or particulars
response.reason: The item is clearly a motorcycle by type, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified brand, unverified working condition, unverified papers) even though the Suzuki claim and 'no fault' claim are unconfirmed from the single rear-angle photo.
